title: Amendment of the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Adjudicators) Regulation of 2019 and the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Contractors) Regulations, No.1 of 2017
decision_details: - The proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to submit the following Regulations, made under the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014 and published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2430/13 dated 2025-04-01, to Parliament for approval, by amending the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Adjudicators) Regulation of 2019 published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2113/63 dated 2019-03-08 and the Construction Industry Development (Registration of Contractors) Regulations, No.1 of 2017 published by the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2057/5 dated 2018‑02‑05, was approved by the Cabinet.* Regulations made under section 58 of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014, read with subsection (2) of section 52 of the aforesaid Act.* Regulations made under section 58 of the Construction Industry Development Act, No.33 of 2014,  read with subsections (1), (2) and (4) of section 35 of the aforesaid Act.
